title: app_profile — application profile (pipeline input; approved addition in decision record 001 D10)
description: Input file describing the access parameters of the system under test (design document 1 §6). Written by a human; consumed and validated by Stage 0 / Stage 2.5. Carries no metadata envelope (it is not a stage artifact but the starting input of the pipeline). Credentials themselves are never stored: credential fields are always references to environment variable names (D10/D12).

base_url.description: Entry URL of the system under test

offline_url_rewrite.description: Recording-only deterministic URL rewrite applied before offline reconstruction.

auth.description: Authentication configuration. form_login keeps the real Stage 0 browser login flow; api_token describes a Stage 2.5 direct tool login that obtains an Authorization token; cookie_session describes a direct tool login that captures the session cookie from Set-Cookie; none means the target needs no Authorization/Cookie.

method.description: Authentication method. form_login = browser form login; api_token = tool-issued API login that obtains an Authorization token; cookie_session = tool-issued login that captures the session cookie from Set-Cookie; none = no Authorization/Cookie.

login_entry.description: Login page entry (path relative to base_url, e.g. /#/login). Required for form_login.

credentials_ref.description: Credential references by environment variable name. Required for form_login/api_token; not needed for none.

token_scheme.description: Optional: scheme of the Authorization header (e.g. Token, Bearer); defaults to Token. Used by probes and replay when building the authentication header — system-specific parameters are injected through the profile rather than hard-coded (approved addition in decision record 002 §7.2/D19).

probe_endpoint.description: Authentication probe endpoint (e.g. a 'current user'-type endpoint), expected to return 2xx. Required for form_login; optional for api_token; optional for none.

logout_endpoint.description: Optional: the exact session-teardown endpoint of this actor. Declared, never inferred from path wording; a write to it is a session transaction, not a business producer.

api_token.description: Tool-issued API-token login configuration used by Stage 2.5 / explicit experiment entry points. Required when auth.method=api_token; optional for form_login, where it replaces the legacy hard-coded Conduit login.

cookie_session.description: Tool-issued cookie-session login configuration used by Stage 2.5 / explicit experiment entry points. Required when auth.method=cookie_session; records only the cookie name/source, the cookie value is used only in memory at run time.

session_maintenance.description: Optional: session maintenance endpoints declared explicitly per actor. Only exact method/path matches are allowed; inferring from the wording of a path is forbidden.

actors.description: Optional additional actor authentication configurations. The top-level auth always represents the reserved actor_id=default; this array must not repeat default. actor_id uniqueness is enforced by the cross-item validator of the app_profile Pydantic model.

reset.description: Optional: environment-level reset facility. Consumed by Stage 2.5 when trust_basis=environment_reset; absent means the profile declares no environment-level reset.

rate_limit.description: Client-side throttle gate parameters (D9; minimal V1 version: concurrency limit + minimum request interval; the remaining fields are reserved in their full form and not consumed by V1)

retry_on_429.description: Consumed by V1: the 429/Retry-After retry path exists (cannot be triggered on the local Conduit; covered by unit tests). Different in kind from burst_bucket/per_host (purely reserved).

burst_bucket.description: Reserved: full form of the burst bucket (not implemented in V1)

per_host.description: Reserved: full form of per-host partitioning (not implemented in V1)

drive_mode.description: Drive mode, lifted unchanged into a top-level run_config field (001 D10). V1 produces only manual/replay; the others are reserved values.

write_probe_safety.description: Reserved optional contract field (not required in V1; deliberately trimmed, not omitted by oversight; an item of the 'must at least include' list in design document 1 §6): write-probe safety policy

exploration_hints.description: Reserved optional contract field (not required in V1; deliberately trimmed, not omitted by oversight): exploration hints (initial entry, key actions)

read_semantic_endpoints.description: Exact method/path pairs whose write-method requests carry read semantics (for example a POST statistics or search endpoint whose body is the selector). Declared requests are not mutations for UI-action anchoring, not producers, and read-like for the proposer, the binder and the runtime observer check; nothing is inferred from path wording.

actor_id.description: Stable actor identifier within the test scenario; default is reserved for the top-level auth.

path.description: Exact canonical path relative to base_url; must not contain a query or fragment.
Exact canonical path relative to base_url; must not contain a query or fragment.

locator.description: POSIX path relative to the repository root; the checkpoint preflight checks existence and hash.

credentials_ref.description: Credential references by environment variable name (only variable names, never the credentials themselves)

email_env.description: Environment variable holding the login email/username

password_env.description: Environment variable holding the login password

path.description: API path relative to base_url (e.g. /api/user); may contain a query.

unauthenticated_status.description: Optional expected status for the same protected probe under a fresh empty session.

expect_json_path.description: Optional JSON path that must be present in the authenticated probe response.

expect_json_equals.description: Optional exact typed value required at expect_json_path.

path.description: Exact canonical path relative to base_url; must not contain a query or fragment.
Login API path relative to base_url.

headers.description: Extra headers for the login request; values must be strings and must not contain real secrets.

body_template.description: JSON body template of the login request. Use the ${email} / ${password} placeholders to reference credentials_ref; real credentials must not be written.

token_json_path.description: JSONPath that extracts the token from the login response JSON, e.g. $.user.token.

recording_activation.description: Optional: how Stage 0 recording establishes this token session in the browser. browser_form drives the real login page with the selectors below and reads the token out of the login response observed by the recorder; api_then_inject issues the login request from the page context and then installs the token through browser_activation. Absent means the legacy hard-coded Conduit form_login path is used unchanged.

selectors.description: Optional: login-page selectors for recording_activation=browser_form; every omitted selector keeps its legacy Conduit default.

browser_activation.description: Required when recording_activation=api_then_inject: where the obtained token is installed in the browser context before navigating to the entry page.

username.description: Username/email input selector; must match exactly one element. Default: input[name="email"].

password.description: Password input selector; must match exactly one element. Default: input[name="password"].

submit.description: Submit control selector; must match exactly one element. Default: form button.

ready.description: Optional post-login readiness selector; must become visible and match exactly one element.

timeout_ms.description: Optional per-control attach/readiness timeout; defaults to 30000. A client-rendered login page mounts its form only after hydration, so each control is waited for before uniqueness is checked.

storage.description: Where the front end keeps the session material.

key.description: Storage key or cookie name, e.g. umami.auth.

value_template.description: Stored value template; ${token} is substituted with the token observed in the login response. Use "${token}" (with the JSON quotes) when the front end stores a JSON string.

entry_url.description: Optional path relative to base_url that recording navigates to after the token is installed; defaults to base_url itself.

cookie_path.description: Optional cookie Path when storage=cookie; defaults to /.

path.description: Login API path relative to base_url.

headers.description: Extra headers for the login request; values must be strings and must not contain real secrets.

body_template.description: JSON body template of the login request. Use the ${email} / ${password} placeholders to reference credentials_ref; real credentials must not be written.

cookie_name.description: Optional: name of the cookie expected to be captured from Set-Cookie; defaults to the first cookie in the login response.

cookie_path.description: Optional: expected cookie Path; only for profile auditing / reserved for a future cookie jar, does not drive the current minimal loop.

cookie_domain.description: Optional: expected cookie Domain; only for profile auditing / reserved for a future cookie jar, does not drive the current minimal loop.

csrf.description: Optional: dynamic CSRF double-submit for frameworks that reject an unaccompanied login POST (Django/allauth, Rails, Laravel). Absent means the login request carries only the static headers above, exactly as before.

cookie_name.description: Cookie the application sets when the entry page is first fetched, e.g. csrftoken.

header_name.description: Request header the login request must echo the cookie value in, e.g. X-CSRFToken.

command.description: argv of the reset command, executed from the repository root.

script.description: Path of the reset script, resolved from the repository root; the implementation treats it as equivalent to bash <script>.

path.description: Relative path used to confirm the baseline after reset; may contain a query.

expect_json_path.description: Optional: JSONPath assertion on the response after reset.

expect_json_equals.description: Optional: the value at expect_json_path should equal this JSON value.
